stem: A skin graze heals as new cells replace damaged tissue. A student proposes that the new cells arise through mitosis but receive genetic instructions different from one another. Which interpretation best applies the deck's account to this situation?

Mitosis produces genetically varied cells when damaged tissue is repaired.
